gen-nixie-one-gf-asta-sans: Asta Sans reads friendly and unfussy, with tubelike lines that never clog up. And Nixie One adds a retro-tech glow on top, its open curves giving the pair its strongest quality: a gentle nostalgia.
gen-nixie-one-gf-bai-jamjuree: Nostalgic from the first letter, Nixie One draws open curves with a single constant stroke. Bai Jamjuree does the quieter job, keeping its round letters light and unpinched where the heading plays up the retro-tech mood.
gen-nixie-one-gf-barlow: Neon-tube strokes with a retro hum, Nixie One up top and Barlow tracing the same constant line below. It stays approachable line after line.
gen-nixie-one-gf-biz-udgothic: Nixie One looks like neon glass tubing. BIZ UDGothic is much lighter in touch, with a wide channel into every bowl, so a larger heading size lets the glow stand out.
gen-nixie-one-gf-biz-udpgothic: Nostalgic and a bit retro-tech, Nixie One draws like a ballpoint, with no pressure in the line. BIZ UDPGothic follows with lavish spacing and clear channels into its rounds, so the heading hums while the text breathes.
gen-nixie-one-gf-bpmf-huninn: Bpmf Huninn brings a modern, single-weight outline feel with a wide channel into every bowl. And Nixie One sits above it with open curves and a retro-tech charm, so the page feels both old and new.
gen-nixie-one-gf-bpmf-zihi-kai-std: Nixie One draws its bowls and stems at the same weight, a nostalgic, retro-tech look. Bpmf Zihi Kai Std has thin strokes of respectable weight, so a slightly larger body size would suit it nicely.
gen-nixie-one-gf-cairo: Nostalgic and retro-tech, Nixie One has a blunt, round-tip marker feel from end to end, while Cairo has a wide channel into every bowl. They share the page without fuss.
gen-nixie-one-gf-cairo-play: Cairo Play reads clearly, with open round letters that hold up at small sizes. Under Nixie One's identical bar thickness, a full page of text would feel modern and easy to move through.
gen-nixie-one-gf-cambay: Cut cord and cracked bangles. Nixie One has rounded strokes like cut lengths of cord, and Cambay brings rounds that gap just like a bangle, giving the pair a contemporary, retro-tech charm.
